title: Wishes and regrets: review
instructionEs: Preguntas mezcladas de toda la unidad.

items.prompt: I hope you ___ a good time at the party tonight.
If only I ___ my umbrella! I'm soaking wet.
items.explanationEs: Arrepentimiento del pasado: if only + had + participio.

items.statement: I wish I were on holiday now.
items.explanationEs: Deseo sobre el presente con to be: were (o was).

items.statement: I should have went to the doctor.
items.explanationEs: Después de should have, el participio: should have gone.

answers: I wish you would listen to me.
items.explanationEs: Queja sobre lo que hace otra persona: wish + would.

items.text: It's raining. I wish it ___ (to be) sunny.
items.explanationEs: Deseo sobre el presente: were (o was).

items.text: I'm hungry. I ___ (should / eat) breakfast this morning.
items.explanationEs: Lo que habría sido correcto: should have + participio (eaten).

items.sentence: I wish I hadn't say that.
items.explanationEs: Después de hadn't, el participio: said.
